title: Sundiata Keita (The Lion King of Mali)
biography: Founder of the Mali Empire who defeated the Sosso king Sumanguru Kante at the Battle of Kirina and proclaimed the Kouroukan Fouga, one of the world's earliest constitutional charters of human rights.
internationalConnections: Unified the Mandinka clans and secured the trans-Saharan gold-salt trade routes.
